question: Will BTC remain above $75,000 throughout September 2026 (UTC)?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the BTC/USD spot price does not touch or fall to $75,000 or below at any point during September 2026 (UTC), as confirmed by available exchange and aggregator data.
- "No": Wins if the BTC/USD spot price touches or falls to $75,000 or below at any point during September 2026 (UTC), as confirmed by available exchange and aggregator data.

Clarification:
- "Throughout September" means the full calendar month of September 2026, from 00:00:00 UTC on September 1, 2026 through 23:59:59 UTC on September 30, 2026.
